subject: Private VPC: scheduled pinwave, network changes & rollback confirmation
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@acmehealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC: scheduled pinwave, network changes & rollback confirmation

Rafael,

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Per our internal change board we need to lock the maintenance window and verify the networking change list before Thursday's pinwave. Two asks from our side:

1) Can Redwood confirm the exact upgrade phasing (node groups, control-plane-first or rolling) and the version-pin strategy for model and runtime images? We need this for our change ticket.
2) Please provide the explicit rollback criteria you will use (metrics + human gates). We must ensure we can rapidly restore traffic to the previous pinned version if anything degrades.

Attached is our proposed change window (ACME-change-window.xlsx) and the current firewall rule set snapshot. If you need additional network evidence (BGP graphs, VRF mappings), ping our infra lead.

-Lena
Lena Park
Head of Infrastructure
Acme Health

Attachment: ACME-change-window.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC: scheduled pinwave, network changes & rollback confirmation

Thanks Lena — clear asks. Draft answers below and attached is a short MOP (maintenance ops playbook) for your review: 20260418-pinwave-mop.pdf

Planned approach (high level):
- Phases: infra-prep -> control-plane patch -> node group stagger (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%) -> KV cache warmup -> telemetry validation window.
- Version pinning: we will pin the customer’s fleet to the previous stable runtime image (v2.11.3) for the first stage and stage-up to v2.12.0 only after successful canaries. Pin metadata will be recorded in the cluster config and the Redwood private control plane; pin must be reversible to v2.11.3 via the rollback API.
- Networking changes: we will apply the ACL diffs in two micro-waves: control-plane peers first, then compute subnet rules. We will not modify BGP next-hops during the window unless we see traffic path failures.

Rollback criteria (automated triggers):
- >5% increase in 5m p99 latency across pinned routes for 3 consecutive 5m buckets.
- >3% error-rate delta for request volume >1000 RPS in a 10m window.
- Unhealthy replica count exceeding 8% of the node group for 5m.

Human gates: on any automated trigger the runbook will pause the wave and auto-open a severity call. SRE or Redwood on-call must approve either: (a) continue with mitigation steps, or (b) execute automated rollback to v2.11.3. Rollback plan will revert images and reapply cached KV state (we keep a snapshot prior to the wave).

Pre-checks we will run 24h and 1h out:
- Network connectivity smoke (BGP, route reflectors).
- TLS cert validity checks and OCSP responses.
- Telemetry ingestion sanity and tracing sampling check.

Please confirm whether your change board requires additional SLAs for the rollback timeline (we estimate full revert within 14 minutes from rollback start for a standard 16-node pool).

I attached the MOP and a diff of expected ACL changes (network-change-diff.txt). If that looks good we'll lock the window: Thu Apr 22 02:00-05:00 UTC.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Senior PM, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20260418-pinwave-mop.pdf, network-change-diff.txt

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Private VPC: scheduled pinwave, network changes & rollback confirmation

On Sat, Apr 18, 2026 at 11:05 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com> wrote:
> Planned approach (high level):
> - Phases: infra-prep -> control-plane patch -> node group stagger (canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%) -> KV cache warmup -> telemetry validation window.

Quick notes from SRE:
- BGP prep: please confirm Acme will pre-seed the new AS-path filters 2 hours before the window. We need that to avoid route flap during the control-plane restart.
- Firewall: control-plane egress must allow our telemetry endpoints 443/8443; if Acme's ACLs block those we will not be able to validate health quickly.
- Rollback threshold: recommend tightening the latency trigger to >4% p99 increase for the canary phase only (we can relax to 5% for full roll). During canary we must be more conservative.

I also added a small operation: add a healthcheck on /live that returns build id and pinned-commit hash. That makes verification deterministic and shortens human decision time.

-Monica
Monica Patel
SRE Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC: scheduled pinwave, network changes & rollback confirmation

Monica + Rafael — noted. A couple of implementation confirmations from infra: 

1) Rollback mechanism: we'll bake an automated job that flips the fleet image tag and simultaneously runs a state-sync to restore KV snapshot-20260418 (snapshot stored in encrypted S3 on Acme VPC). The job produces a runbook entry with timestamps and artifacts. Estimated revert completion ~12 minutes for 16-node pools; documented variance in MOP.

2) Health signals and runbook hooks: the job will evaluate the /live healthcheck Monica suggested, p99 latency, and a token-sampled trace rate. If any two of three signals cross the canary threshold the job will abort the wave and initiate the rollback.

3) Network safety: Soojin and I will create a temporary route-policy that pins traffic eligible for canary to the patched nodes only (flow-steering using tag-based Egress) so we can reduce blast radius. This requires a short-lived BGP community from Acme; Lena, can you confirm if you can emit community 0xAC:0x22 for canary traffic?

If Acme confirms communities and pre-seeds filters we are green to lock Thu Apr 22 02:00-05:00 UTC. I'll push the automation and post the runbook link in INF-4523.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference

(On Tue, Apr 20, 2026 at 15:00 Lena Park <lena.park@acmehealth.com> wrote: Thanks — will confirm community within 2 hours.)
